checks.criterion: Main navigation reaches About, Services, and Contact pages
checks.name: main-navigation-routes
checks.evidence: Clicked About, Services, and Contact from primary navigation; each URL and H1 loaded successfully.

checks.name: services-overview-catalogue

checks.criterion: Each service detail page is crawlable and scannable
checks.name: service-detail-pages-scannable
checks.evidence: Visited all four service URLs; each exposed matching H1, overview, inclusions, exclusions, Pricing on request, process, timeline, requirements, and enquiry CTA.

checks.criterion: Contact flow opens a prefilled written enquiry

checks.criterion: Responsive accessible presentation works on mobile
checks.name: mobile-accessible-responsive

checks.criterion: SEO foundation is present and corrected

checks.criterion: Static MVP has no account, payment, form backend, analytics, or cookie gate
